description: Add a note to an incident. Only the people who can see the incident in OneUptime can read an internal note; public notes are posted to the status page for subscribers/customers. Markdown is supported.

incidentId.description: UUID of the incident to annotate.

visibility.description: Where the note is visible: 'internal' (only the people who can see the incident, default) or 'public' (posted to the status page).

name: add_incident_note
title: Add Incident Note
